note_tweet.text:
Cillian Murphy is called the strangest actor in Britain, 

After "Peaky Blinders" when his face became known all over the world, he didn't choose the path that every actor chooses at that point.

These days most stars open an Instagram, get millions of followers, sign contracts with big brands, walk the red carpets, and do everything possible to stay in the spotlight.

But Cillian chose differently.

He didn't create social media, didn't sell his life for likes and views, and didn't try to turn himself into a media product. He was never interested in fame for fame's sake. He said in an interview that an actor should disappear behind the role, not turn himself into a character of show business.

When the world expected glamorous parties and loud scandals from him, he simply returned home to Ireland. There he lives a quiet, almost invisible life, far from the cameras. And that's his "strangeness".

In my opinion, this is not strange. This is being an introvert, this is being humble. This is what a true gentleman is. People say Thomas Shelby has an aura, but actually it's Cillian Murphy who has the aura.

He is one of the classiest men in entertainment. A real, genuinely authentic person with all the right values. A polished and reserved actor who doesn't look for ego strokes. That's why we love him the way he is.
